name: x_search
description: Search public X (Twitter) posts, profiles, and threads. Read-only discovery only: use this for current discussion, reactions, or claims on public X rather than general web pages. Depending on how the user set up X search, Grok answers with the posts it cites, or X's own search returns matching posts with links. Do not use it to post, reply, like, DM, upload media, delete, or inspect the user's authenticated X account.

query.description: What to look up on X.

allowed_x_handles.description: Optional list of X handles to include exclusively (max 10).

excluded_x_handles.description: Optional list of X handles to exclude (max 10).

from_date.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enable_image_understanding.description: Whether Grok should analyze images attached to matching X posts. Ignored by X's own search.

enable_video_understanding.description: Whether Grok should analyze videos attached to matching X posts. Ignored by X's own search.
